title: The Stormy English Practice
segments: Linh sat at her small table, ready to practice English writing. She opened her notebook, eager to describe her day. Suddenly, a strong wind hit her window. Outside, the sky turned dark grey. Rain started to fall heavily, like a bão số 2 was coming. Loud thunder boomed, making her jump. It was hard to focus on her English now.

Because of the loud thunder, Linh couldn't focus on her writing. After some time, her stomach rumbled loudly. She felt very hungry. The storm outside grew even stronger. Linh looked out the window. Big raindrops hit the glass. It was impossible to go outside now, to a market or a restaurant. What could she do?

Because of this, Linh had an idea. She could order food online! She thought, 'This is a good chance to practice my English writing!' She decided to write a clear, polite message for her order. It needed to be perfect. She opened her laptop, ready to find a nice restaurant that delivered in the storm.

After that, Linh found a small cafe online that delivered hot noodles. She started writing her order. She typed slowly, choosing each word carefully. She also added a special note in English. "Please, can I have extra chili sauce?" she wrote. Then, she added, "Thank you very much for coming in this bad weather!" She felt proud of her message.

After that, Linh waited patiently. The storm outside was still strong, but soon, a knock came at her door. It was the delivery driver, holding a warm bag of noodles! Linh smiled brightly. 'Thank you so much for bringing this in the storm,' she said clearly in English. The driver nodded. Linh felt a wave of happiness and pride.

Because of this, Linh happily took the warm noodles inside. She placed them on her small table and began to eat. The spicy chili sauce was perfect! She felt warm and satisfied. After her meal, Linh opened her English notebook again. She felt proud. Her writing practice had helped her get delicious food, even during the storm.
endWrap: Linh learned that day that practice makes perfect, even when facing challenges. She knew her English skills would continue to grow, just like her confidence.
